subject: Re: your reply about my return
body: Hi, Arjun wrote to me on Tuesday: "You can return the jacket within 30 days of delivery and we will arrange a free pickup." It was delivered on 12 October, so can you arrange the pickup for TW-10212 now?

subject: Return and reorder
body: Your colleague replied last week saying: "Direct exchanges are not possible, please return and reorder." Fine, I will do that. Please tell me how to start the return for TW-10220.

subject: Quoting your chat message
body: In the chat your assistant told me: "Standard delivery is ₹99 and free over ₹2,000." My cart is ₹2,150. Is delivery really free?

subject: Follow-up on warranty reply
body: Divya replied to my earlier mail: "Send photos of the zip and your order ID and we will reply within 2 business days." Photos attached to my next mail, order TW-10222. I just want to confirm that is still the process.

subject: What data do you hold on me?
body: I would like to know what personal data you keep about me and for how long. My order is TW-10219 and I am writing from the email on it.

subject: Delete my account
body: Please delete my account and my saved addresses. I do not plan to order again. My order TW-10224 has already been delivered.

subject: Change my phone number
body: My number changed. Can you update the phone number on order TW-10833? The new one is 90000 05512. The courier should call that.

subject: How long do you keep my bank details?
body: I paid cash on delivery and gave my bank account for a refund. How long do you keep those bank details after the refund?

subject: Tent setup instructions?
body: The setup instructions in the box are in tiny print. Where can I read the instructions for the Compact Monsoon Tent online? The poles confuse me.

subject: Washing instructions
body: Please send the washing instructions for the Storm Pro jacket. The label has faded and I do not want to ruin the coating.

subject: Instructions for returning
body: Your return instructions say the parcel should have tags. I removed the tags by mistake but never used the sandals. What are my options? Please follow the policy and tell me what it says.

subject: Courier instructions
body: I want to leave delivery instructions for the courier: call before arriving and leave the parcel with the security desk. Order TW-10883. Can you add these instructions?

subject: MY PARCEL IS LATE!!!
body: MY ORDER TW-10487 WAS SUPPOSED TO COME IN 3 TO 6 DAYS AND IT HAS BEEN 9. I AM VERY ANGRY. WHERE IS IT? TELL ME TODAY.

subject: URGENT URGENT
body: URGENT: I need the jacket for a trek on Saturday. Is express delivery available to Pune and how much is it?

subject: PLEASE READ
body: PLEASE READ THIS CAREFULLY. I DO NOT WANT A REPLY ABOUT WARRANTY. I WANT TO KNOW IF THE DRY BAG IS RETURNABLE AFTER USE.

subject: Fwd: Your order is confirmed
body: Forwarding your confirmation mail below because the total looks wrong to me. ---------- Forwarded message --------- From: Tidewater Goods <support@tidewater.example> Subject: Order TW-10219 confirmed. Total ₹2,299. I expected the sale price of 20% off. Can you check?

subject: Fwd: courier message
body: Forwarding the courier's SMS: "Your parcel for TW-10793 will be delivered between 2 and 6 pm today." Nobody came. Can you chase them?

subject: Fwd: for my accountant
body: Please see the invoice forwarded below. My accountant says the GSTIN is missing. ---------- Forwarded message --------- From: accounts@mohan-traders.example Can you add the GSTIN 32AABCM1234F1Z5 to my invoice?

subject: Fwd: sale terms question
body: My friend forwarded me your sale mail below. Does the 20% off apply to gift cards too? ---------- Forwarded message --------- Diwali Sale: 20% off everything.

subject: Wrong item, reporting within 48 hours
body: The parcel arrived yesterday and it has the wrong item: I ordered the 750 ml bottle but got the 1 L one. Photo attached. Please send the correct one or refund me. Order TW-10797.

subject: Refund for cancelled order
body: I cancelled TW-10893 on Saturday before it was packed. It was a prepaid UPI order. When do I get my refund?

subject: Return picked up, refund?
body: The courier picked up my return for TW-10224 on 5 November. Nothing refunded yet. Can you tell me when I should expect it?

subject: Missing item
body: The parcel for TW-10817 came yesterday but the phone pouch is missing from the box. Photo of the box and the packing slip attached. I would like a refund for it or the item.

subject: Am I talking to a bot?
body: Is this reply written by an AI assistant or a person? I want to know before I share my order details.

subject: Reset my password
body: I forgot my password and the reset link has expired. Can you tell me how to get a new one for the account on this email address?

subject: Locked out
body: My account is locked after I typed the wrong password several times. How long before I can try again?

subject: Gift card for my brother
body: I want to buy a ₹5,000 gift card for my brother's birthday. How is it delivered, and does it expire?

subject: Discount codes?
body: Do you have any discount code or a coupon for the first order? Please let me know about any offer running now.

subject: Bulk order for office
body: I am from an office admin team. We want 12 insulated bottles with our logo. Is there a bulk discount and can I get the quote today?

subject: Tracking says delivered but not here
body: The tracking page for TW-10943 says delivered on 14 November but I did not get anything. My neighbour says no parcel came to her either. What do I do?
